scope: Synthetic computational study of the declared fixed-flow thermal equation; no environmental accuracy claim
smooth_profile_generation: 0.2 sin(pi*y/(2H)) sigmoid(offset + sum_{n=1..5} a_n cos(n*pi*y/H)/n), seeded Gaussian coefficients, offset uniform[-0.5,0.5]
comparators: uniform-entrance amplitude fitted to all observations
two-mode Graetz least-squares fitted to all observations

acceptance.analytical_plug_refinement: Observe convergence and report actual errors; no preselected winning result
acceptance.comparison: Report every comparator, signed errors, median/mean/max errors and endpoint worst-case loss; do not claim midpoint wins average error

information_rule: Operational forecasts use stations at/upstream of 0.04 m only. Endpoint observations downstream of this origin may appear only in explicitly retrospective theorem demonstrations, never as operational forecast inputs.
